name: restruct/silverstripe-seo
description: SEO essentials for Silverstripe CMS 6: meta title, description fallback, robots (meta + X-Robots-Tag), canonical (tag + Link header), Open Graph with fallbacks, and a sitemap bridge.

suggest.wilr/silverstripe-googlesitemaps: sitemap.xml; pages set to noindex are left out of it automatically
suggest.dnadesign/silverstripe-elemental: content blocks; later versions of this module check the rendered page, blocks included
suggest.restruct/silverstripe-ai: optional AI suggestions in a later version
